overall.why_en: AI-rig any static mesh (esp. animals/creatures)

monthly.note: 本月(2026年9月)發佈的遊戲模組 Rigging 工具不足5個，故以最近期(2026年8月)的正式發佈補充。Tripo Auto-Rigging (Uni-Rig) 雖非本月全新發佈，但因其在9月仍為業界焦點且功能持續活躍，故列入榜單並標示為非新發佈。
monthly.note_en: Fewer than 5 game model rigging tools were released this month (September 2026), so the list is supplemented with recent official releases from August 2026. Tripo Auto-Rigging (Uni-Rig) is not a brand new release this month, but it remains a prominent tool in September and its features are actively discussed, hence its inclusion with 'isNew' set to false.

items.name: Meshy 7
items.why: Meshy 7 引入了四足動物自動綁骨功能，顯著擴展了其 AI 綁骨的適用範圍，使其能處理更多樣化的角色類型。
items.why_en: Meshy 7 introduced quadruped auto-rigging, significantly expanding its AI rigging capabilities to handle a wider variety of character types.

items.name: Autodesk Flow Studio AI Rigging
items.why: Autodesk Flow Studio 推出 3D Editor + Canvas，強化了角色創建與綁骨工作流程的整合性，並新增 MetaHuman 身體動畫導出功能，提升與 Unreal Engine 的協作效率。
items.why_en: Autodesk Flow Studio launched 3D Editor + Canvas, enhancing the integration of character creation and rigging workflows, and added MetaHuman body animation export for improved collaboration with Unreal Engine.

items.name: Cascadeur 2026.2.1
items.why: Cascadeur 2026.2.1 是該 AI 輔助動畫軟體的最新穩定版本，持續提供物理基礎的動畫與綁骨工具，並進行了多項改進。
items.why_en: Cascadeur 2026.2.1 is the latest stable release of this AI-assisted animation software, continuing to offer physics-based animation and rigging tools with various improvements.

items.name: Armature
items.why: Armature 是一款新發佈的免費 AI 輔助獨立角色綁骨與蒙皮工具，專為遊戲、動畫和 VFX 工作設計，支援多種 3D 格式導出。
items.why_en: Armature is a newly released free AI-assisted standalone character rigging and skinning tool designed for games, animation, and VFX work, supporting export in various 3D formats.

items.name: Tripo Auto-Rigging
items.why: Tripo 的 AI 綁骨功能持續活躍並受到關注，提供快速的自動綁骨和動畫重定向，是從 3D 模型到可動角色的高效解決方案。
items.why_en: Tripo's AI auto-rigging capabilities remain active and prominent, offering fast automatic rigging and animation retargeting as an efficient solution for transforming 3D models into animatable characters.

categories.name: 創建聲音特效

overall.name: ElevenLabs SFX v2 + v3 voice
overall.why: 遊戲音訊最全:文字轉 SFX(30s、可無縫循環)+ 頂級語音
overall.why_en: Most complete game-audio stack: text-to-SFX (30s, seamless loops) + top-tier voice

overall.name: Suno v5
overall.why: 音樂盲測第一(ELO 1293);全曲+人聲質量標竿
overall.why_en: #1 in music blind tests (ELO 1293); full-song + vocal benchmark

overall.name: ElevenLabs Music v2
overall.why: 商用授權清晰,可在曲中嵌 SFX、中途換曲風
overall.why_en: Clear commercial licensing; embed SFX in tracks, mid-track genre switch

overall.name: Stable Audio 3
overall.why: 開源,音樂 + SFX/foley 統一,適合自架 pipeline
overall.why_en: Open-source; unified music + SFX/foley; great for self-hosted pipelines

overall.name: Lyria 3 Pro
overall.why: 最長 3 分鐘結構化曲目,SynthID 浮水印
overall.why_en: Up to 3-min structured tracks; SynthID watermark

items.name: Firefly AI 音訊工具 (生成音樂、語音、音效)
items.why: Adobe 正式發布其 Firefly AI 音訊工具套件，涵蓋音樂、語音和音效生成，為創作者提供全面的音訊解決方案，並支援商業用途。
items.why_en: Adobe officially launched its Firefly AI audio tool suite, covering music, speech, and sound effect generation, offering comprehensive audio solutions for creators with commercial use support.

items.name: Suno Studio 2.0
items.why: Suno Studio 2.0 將其領先的 AI 音樂生成平台升級為類似 DAW 的環境，新增 MIDI 支援、進階編輯、自動化和 AI 聊天機器人，並於 9 月初進行了進一步更新。
items.why_en: Suno Studio 2.0 upgraded its leading AI music generation platform to a DAW-like environment, adding MIDI support, advanced editing, automation, and an AI chatbot, with further updates in early September.

items.name: Melody Flip
items.why: Roland 推出 AI 輔助的旋律生成 DAW 外掛，幫助製作人從音訊或風格選擇中發現音樂創意，是本月最新的音樂創作工具。
items.why_en: Roland launched an AI-assisted melody generation DAW plugin, helping producers discover musical ideas from audio or style selections, making it this month's newest music creation tool.

items.name: Sound Effects 1.0
items.why: Sonilo 與 fal 合作推出 Sound Effects 1.0，能從影片或文字生成高度逼真的音效，專為實際製作工作流程設計。
items.why_en: Sonilo, in partnership with fal, launched Sound Effects 1.0, capable of generating highly realistic sound effects from video or text, designed for real production workflows.

items.name: Eleven v3
items.why: ElevenLabs 於 8 月正式推出其最富有表現力的 AI 語音模型 Eleven v3，支援 70 多種語言和內聯音訊標籤，大幅提升語音生成控制力。
items.why_en: ElevenLabs officially rolled out its most expressive AI voice model, Eleven v3, in August, supporting over 70 languages and inline audio tags, significantly enhancing voice generation control.
